tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记组织功能
创建笔记组织前端页面

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database model for notes with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags.
T1.notes: Ensure the model supports scalability and flexibility for future features.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes using a backend framework like Django or Express.js.
T2.notes: Include proper authentication and validation mechanisms.

T3.implementation_approach: Build a frontend page using a framework like React or Vue.js to display, create, and edit notes.
T3.notes: Focus on a user-friendly interface with responsive design.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement functionality to organize notes into folders or categories, allowing users to group and filter notes.
T4.notes: Consider adding drag-and-drop or tagging features for better usability.

T5.implementation_approach: Create a frontend page to manage note organization, displaying folders or categories and their associated notes.
T5.notes: Ensure seamless integration with the backend and intuitive navigation.
